requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: Required Courses: ACC 210 - Financial Accounting 3 credits; BUS 230 - Personal Finance 3 credits; BUS 330 - Principles of Finance 3 credits

requirements.label: electives
requirements.title: Electives
requirements.sourceText: Electives: Choose 3 courses (9 credits) from the below electives: ACC 214 - Managerial Cost Analysis and Applications 3 credits; BUS 355 - Investment Analysis 3 credits; BUS 365 - Financial Management 3 credits; BUS 367 - Python for Finance 3 credits

rule.text: Students may apply a maximum of nine transfer credits toward the Finance Minor.
